Windows scans less. You stay connected.

03

Scan when you ask

Open the Windows Wi-Fi panel when you want to look for networks. On-demand discovery remains available.

Honest little utility

One job. No nonsense.

Penguin Anti-Scan does not promise magical internet. It targets one possible source of Wi-Fi latency spikes: periodic background network scans.

  • Does not turn off the Wi-Fi radio
  • Does not intentionally disconnect your network
  • Does not install a custom driver or service
  • Restores normal scanning when you exit safely

Good questions

Before you let a penguin near your Wi-Fi

Can it fix Wi-Fi ping spikes?

It may help when the spikes come from periodic WLAN scans or roaming behavior. It cannot fix congestion, interference, weak signal, router issues, or bufferbloat.

Why does it need administrator access?

Windows restricts changes to wireless interface settings. The app requests elevation only when it starts.

How do I know it is working?

The green “Penguin on guard” state appears only after Windows reports that background scanning is disabled.

What happens when I close the window?

It stays active in the system tray. Choose “Exit and restore Wi-Fi” from the tray menu to quit and restore normal scanning.
